title: Evoked responses to elevated sounds
description: EEG dataset of evoked responses to noise bursts presented from loudspeakers at different elevations in a hemi-anechoic chamber. It combines two experiments, a deviant detection task with adapter and probe sounds and a one-back localization task. In the one-back task, a subset of participants was also tested with ear molds that disrupt elevation perception. Participants first completed a sound-elevation localization test, and behavioral responses are included.
methods_description: Pink noise bursts were presented from loudspeakers at several elevations and 10° azimuth in a hemi-anechoic chamber. Experiment I (subjects 001-023) used a long adapter noise followed by a short probe burst from another elevation, with button-press responses to deviants. Experiment II (subjects 100-134) used a long white noise adapter over open headphones followed by a burst from one of four elevations. About 5% of trials were targets that prompted localization of the previous sound. Subjects 130-134 completed a second session with molds inserted to disrupt elevation perception.
